requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online.
Patients should have secure online access to test results after clinician approval.
There should be a mechanism to flag urgent cases for same-day appointments.
The system must be user-friendly, especially for elderly or less tech-savvy patients.
Test results should only be released after clinician review and authorization.
Patients should receive a confirmation notification once their prescription is ready for pickup.
Patients should be able to track the status of their prescription requests.
A secure identity verification process must be implemented for accessing test results.
Data encryption must be used during transmission and storage of patient information.
The portal must include large font sizes and high contrast for improved readability.
The portal must support guided tutorials for common tasks.
The portal must include accessibility features supporting screen readers.
There should be a user support chat function or dedicated help section.
The portal must be mobile-compatible and responsive.
A feedback mechanism must be provided for users to share their experiences.
